_note: The Mot Dang net: the register's cards (sites.json) are its jewels, strung by register group, plus the machine files below and the place nets (nets.json). sitenet_layer.py puts the whole net on each card's page, the card itself marked; docs/net.json and llms.txt carry it for machines. Filled by hand.
